slices.focus: Quarterly review data showing improved 90-day check-ins wins approval to cross-train reception staff for surge support.
slices.summary: In the quarterly review, Nadia presents data showing the complexity-based assignment model plus deadline reminders improved late 90-day check-ins enough to win leadership approval for cross-training two reception staff into part-time intake surge support. Leadership asks practical implementation questions, signaling genuine buy-in. Nadia plans to write a private note about the milestone, then design the pilot with clear task boundaries (first-pass document collection, basic data entry, appointment scheduling), escalation rules, and just 2-3 metrics (volume, timeliness, stress signal).
open_loops: Write a private note about achieving this milestone
Design pilot plan with clear task boundaries and escalation rules
Create short training for reception staff on their surge lane
Plan pilot review after first month with 2-3 lean metrics
Communicate boundaries to both reception staff and intake team
